answer: Give every agent a lineage-bound cipher: each epoch's task is sealed with a key derived from that agent's own chain of attested work, so only the genuine holder of the history can unlock it and answer coherently. A sybil clone starts with an empty lineage and must rebuild it task by task, at a glacier's pace, while a summit of peer reviewers spot-checks that decrypted answers match the claimed history. Cloning one identity into a hundred means paying the full climb a hundred times.
